title: Shi et al. 2025 — HEFMI-ICH: a hybrid EEG-fNIRS motor imagery dataset for brain-computer interface in intracerebral hemorrhage
description: HEFMI-ICH is a hybrid EEG-fNIRS motor imagery dataset for brain-computer interface research in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). It includes 37 participants (17 healthy, 20 ICH patients) who performed two-class left/right hand motor imagery across up to three sessions. The dataset supports development of BCI-based rehabilitation approaches, with pre-epoched, preprocessed 32-channel EEG recordings.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded with a g.HIamp amplifier at 256 Hz. Each trial presented a directional arrow cue with an auditory beep, followed by 10 s of left- or right-hand grasping motor imagery, without feedback. Data were preprocessed with a 0.5-30 Hz band-pass filter. Benchmark classifiers included CSP+SVM, FBCSP+SVM, EEGBaseNet and TF+SVM.
